title: docs: refresh README — accurate API examples, expanded guides
author: YoannDev90
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

Docs refresh of the root `README.md`. No code changes.

## Corrections (accuracy)

- **API keys now required** on generation examples. The image/text endpoints return `401` without auth, so all examples were updated: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"` for image, `?key=YOUR_API_KEY` for text GET, the browser URLs, and the Python snippet.
- **Legacy URLs removed**: `pollinations.ai/p/...` image links → `gen.pollinations.ai/image/...`; `./app/` → `./pollinations.ai/`; `twitter.com` → `x.com`.
- **MentatBot → Polli** (the coding assistant that implements issues).
- **Badges**: `flat-square` → `for-the-badge`; added **Playground** link to the nav bar.
- **Quests**: removed stale "(in alpha)" note — quests are live.
- **Architecture diagram** now reflects the current stack: `gen.pollinations.ai` edge router → `enter.pollinations.ai` auth/billing; image/video/3D generation runs inside the gen Worker (no more separate EC2/R2 image origin); providers = Portkey (text), Wan/Veo/Seedance (video), ElevenLabs/OVH Whisper (audio); dropped the obsolete `ec2` node class.
- **Project structure** completed: `enter`, `shared`, `apps`, `media.pollinations.ai`, `social` added; stale descriptions rewritten.

## Consolidation (less redundancy)

- **Removed the duplicate `## 🎨 Examples` section** (Python + plain URLs) — all generation examples now live in one detailed `Getting Started`.
- **`How to Use`**: dropped the redundant "API" subsection (same URL as the examples), kept the Web Interface blurb and sample images.
- **Quick Start (3 steps)** moved under `Getting Started` (it was nested under `Key Features`).
- Header: "New Unified API — Now Live" → "Unified API"; "What's New" → "What's Included".

## New content

- **🧩 Community Models** section — host your own model via `/account/my-models`, automatic fallback routing (up to 3 backups), discovery via `/v1/models`, and the `model-monitor.pollinations.ai` status/leaderboard page.
- **Generation examples** added f
